# Accurate enough for which decision? (M10)

Swap a fixed multiset of forecast errors between eight moments. MAE and RMSE stay fixed; asymmetric threshold-decision loss changes. Pinned allocations share current actuals and decision assumptions. Drag or native swap selectors; Undo, local saving and Markdown with embedded JSON.

This is a hindsight error-allocation experiment, not a forecast-training method. Independent decisions omit resources, time coupling and financial calibration. Tests cover invariant accuracy, consequence changes, threshold equality and fair baselines.
